memoryRestartVerification.rule: The three matches after the first restart have exact native heap, GPU resource, and checkpoint counts.
memoryRestartVerification.initialResourceDrop: The first match uploads the starting view. The later matches keep the fixed storage view.
memoryRestartVerification.initialStrictAssertions: The first-to-last exact equality checks failed on lower GPU resource counts and 256 KiB of one-time native capacity growth. The raw report was retained. Post-restart counts are exact.

sdkCandidate.fixture: Unchanged Wreck Yard four-player fixture with 400 storage boxes. Rest has 687 physics bodies. Collapse removes 40 supports and checks all 40 top boxes fall.

timings.note: Unchanged fixture. Pair 1 baseline/V3; pair 2 V3/baseline; pair 3 baseline/V3. Extra baseline completed before order-change instruction; preserved, not selected by result. No claim of collapse gain.

namedProfile.note: Separate Node inspector 1ms sampled profiles. 180 actual native steps, V3 first then baseline. Self costs are sample estimates, not invocation counts.
